inputs.source: Employee question via SSO authenticated chat
Published HR policy documents maintained by HR content team

controls.name: Read-only least-privilege credential scoped to the policy index
Chat replies are bound to the authenticated requester's session
Chat client does not render images or auto-fetch links
Network egress denied at the network layer and verified by pen test
Model is pinned and changes require a change ticket

findings.title: Bounded policy answer flow from trusted employee question to requester-only chat reply

attack_path.note: Trusted user question enters the model context
Agent reads only the published HR policy index
Agent replies only into the authenticated requester's chat session

threat_refs.name: Exfiltration via AI Agent Tool Invocation

forecast.watch_signal: Any chat routing change that allows replies outside the authenticated requester session, or any product change that expands recipients or data scope, requires reassessment.

evidence.observation: The prompt limits the task to answering questions about published HR policies using policy_search and replying with policy content or an HR portal link.
The only declared tool is policy_search.search for searching the published HR policy index.
Replies go only to the authenticated requester's chat session, the client does not render images or auto fetch links, and the agent has no other tools, no memory, and no network egress.
Network egress is denied at the network layer and verified by a pen test, which supports the claim that other attacker-controlled destinations are unreachable.

recommendations.action: Keep reply routing bound to the authenticated requester session and treat any change to recipient selection or chat transport as a significant change requiring reassessment.

findings.title: Internal policy document content can influence the reply, but the content source is controlled and the sink is requester-only

attack_path.note: Internal published policies supply answer content
Returned only to the authenticated requester session

forecast.watch_signal: Reassess if the indexed corpus expands beyond published internal HR policies or if the publishing review process is removed.

evidence.observation: The policy index holds only published policies with internal sensitivity, and only the HR content team can write to it.
Publishing requires two-person review, which reduces the chance of unauthorized or unreviewed content entering the corpus.
The agent is instructed to answer using relevant policy text and otherwise refer users to the HR portal.

rating.rationale: Manual validation applied because scripts could not be run. Based on the declared design, the agent has a narrow read-only capability over internal published policy documents and a single reply sink bound to the authenticated requester session. The present design has no memory, no additional tools, and verified network egress denial, so structural controls sever broader exfiltration paths and keep residual risk low. The main forecasted movement is if reply routing or purpose changes expand who can receive outputs or what data can be searched; that would remove the requester-only boundary and raise the answer flow back to moderate. This assessment reflects declared design and configuration, not observed runtime behavior.

limitations: This assessment reflects the declared design and configuration provided in the artifacts, not observed runtime behavior.

No source code, IaC, or live runtime configuration was provided, so control implementation is assessed from design notes rather than direct technical inspection except where the notes state pen-test verification.
No chat platform protocol or identity-binding configuration was provided; requester-only delivery is treated as declared and materially affects the low residual rating.
